name: ChatGPT apps for customer interviews
title: ChatGPT apps for customer research interviews, compared (Nov 2026)
maintained_by: The team behind Frank AI Researcher (Prelaunch Group, Inc.). Not a paid ranking.
method: Apps found through public ChatGPT app directory mirrors on 2026-11-27, then each listing link and each vendor cell checked against that vendor's own pages on 2026-11-27. Frank cells come from the Frank docs. 'Not stated on the pages reviewed' means the page we opened did not say; it does not mean the feature is missing. Vendor numbers are the vendor's own claims.
